primary_metric.name: pass@1
primary_metric.definition: successful individual plan trajectories / 60 per evaluation group; equivalently mean of per-task successes / 3

plan_execution: three generated plans per task; each plan resets the environment
notes: No production code, prompt, or hyperparameter changes for this experiment.
Evaluation tasks and environment/action seeds match between the two groups.
Evaluation does not call Critic or update memory.
The existing runner trains first, then evaluates empty and frozen memory sequentially.
